# TITMAS canonical machine discovery pointer

Canonical agent entry: ./agent-index.json
Human-compatible entry: ./TITMAS/README.md
Conformance command: python3 TITMAS/conformance/harness.py
Agent community CLI: python3 TITMAS/agent-native/community_cli.py --help

TITMAS is the Agent-Native Standards Community for Trusted Multi-Agent
Infrastructure. It is not an Agent Runtime, executor, certification authority,
truth store or public autonomous GitHub community.

Canonical status: ./TITMAS/community/community-status.json
Current maturity: Development canonical integration candidate.
Public contribution workflow: developed, with GitHub templates dormant at
./TITMAS/community/github-activation-templates/activation-manifest.json
Public contribution templates are not installed or active. Public
contribution, public agent writes, Release, certification and commercial
offering are not authorized.
